reference.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: a single source reference photograph for a premium product-turnaround web gallery. Input image 1 is the existing fictional amber fragrance bottle identity reference. Create ONE clean, front-facing 0-degree studio photograph of that same fictional unbranded product, centered symmetrically. Preserve squat rectangular amber glass body, thick clear amber glass base, gently rounded corners, flat shoulders, short narrow amber neck, substantial matte black perfectly cylindrical cap, amber liquid, no label, no text. Approximate bottle body width 240 units, height 235, depth 95; cap width 112 and height 114. Front is wide flat face. Dry polished glass and dry satin cap (remove incidental droplets from the reference), no rocks. Full product upright, total product fills 67% of square image height, base at 83% image height, centered x=50%. Neutral warm charcoal seamless studio background and same neutral charcoal tabletop, very soft grounding shadow, controlled diffused neutral softbox lighting camera-left with subtle right rim, premium catalog photography, crisp glass contours. Camera fixed at bottle mid-height with very slight elevation showing only a narrow top ellipse of cap, long focal length nearly orthographic, no perspective distortion. Image square 1024x1024. This will be the identity, camera, framing, lighting and background master for all future rotated views. No graphics, captions, letters, watermarks, branding, packaging claims, extra objects. One image only.

view_045.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Single photographic turnaround frame of the SAME fictional amber fragrance bottle as input image 1, the master front view. Rotate ONLY the bottle clockwise by 45 degrees as seen from above so front wide face and RIGHT narrow side visible, cap still a cylinder. Camera, lighting, background and object center remain fixed. Preserve exact body/cap proportions, thickness, flat shoulders, thick amber clear base, glass orange-amber tone, no label, cylindrical dry satin black cap, dry glass. Body rectangular thin depth (depth roughly 40% of front width). Full product same exact vertical bounds as reference (cap top 13% canvas, bottle base81%); centered x50%; same square canvas. Nearly orthographic camera at bottle middle with only narrow ellipse top cap. Neutral warm charcoal studio background and tabletop copied from reference, identical diffused lighting and soft grounding shadow. Realistic reflections change naturally with object rotation but light setup stays still. No text, no graphics, no watermark, no branding, no props. One square photo, not contact sheet. This is 45-degree front-right three-quarter view, no front-facing duplicate.

remaining_views.prompt_template: Use case: product-mockup. ONE photographic turnaround frame {angle} degrees of the SAME fictional fragrance bottle. Input1 is master 0-degree reference; input2 is accepted45-degree geometry support. Rotate ONLY object, camera and lighting fixed. REQUIRED VIEW: {description} Preserve SAME rectangular amber glass body with front width240/body height235/depth95 proportions, same dry satin-black cylindrical cap width112 height114, short neck, thick clear amber base, gently rounded corners, flat shoulders, dry glass, same amber color/liquid. All parts same relative dimensions. No label region or printing in reference: keep ALL faces blank. SAME square canvas, full object centered x50%; exact vertical bounds cap top13% and bottle base81%; no cropping or rezoom; cap height must match reference. Camera nearly orthographic, fixed at body midheight, only narrow ellipse of cap top visible. Identical neutral warm charcoal seamless background/tabletop from input1, controlled diffused studio light from camera-left, soft grounding shadow. Realistic glass refractions and reflections naturally change with rotation, no stylistic changes or extra details. Premium catalog photograph. No text, captions, graphic, logos, watermark, props, contact sheet. Single square image.

views.description: pure RIGHT SIDE elevation: the bottle narrow right end faces camera, the wide front and back planes are edge-on. Body width in image approximately 40% of reference front body width, cap width remains unchanged (cap therefore WIDER than body side silhouette). Do NOT widen side to fit cap. Narrow rectangular thick glass body.

BACK-RIGHT three-quarter view at 135 degrees clockwise as viewed from above. See wide BACK panel on image right and narrow right end on image left. The back is plain unlabelled amber glass, same shape as front. This is the reverse counterpart of 45 degree view.

straight BACK elevation at 180 degrees. Wide flat plain back panel faces camera squarely, same wide body silhouette as front, no narrow side visible. Clear thick amber glass edges and base, no text, no label, no new objects inside.

BACK-LEFT three-quarter view at 225 degrees clockwise as seen from above. See wide BACK panel on image left and narrow left end on image right. Back is plain unlabelled amber glass, same shape as front.

pure LEFT SIDE elevation: bottle narrow left end faces camera, wide front and back planes are edge-on. Body width in image approximately 40% of reference front body width, cap width remains unchanged (cap therefore WIDER than body side silhouette). Do NOT widen side to fit cap. Narrow rectangular thick glass body.
FRONT-LEFT three-quarter view at 315 degrees clockwise as seen from above. See wide FRONT panel on image right and narrow LEFT side on image left. Opposite perspective of image2.

processing: Convert accepted PNGs to 1024x1024 WebP quality 86 without altering individual product geometry. Copy the 0-degree image as reference.webp. Assemble a labelled contact sheet for visual review. See scripts/prepare-turnaround.mjs and the public manifest for output/source mappings.
limitations: Nominal viewpoints are approximate. The unlabelled product has front/rear symmetry. Generative reflection and slight cap-width variation remain. No measured geometry or exact unseen-surface fidelity is claimed.
